description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
First calibrated version (same weights as V1): 2-layer 1-head; L1 attn copies last digit; L2 attn sink-mass encodes match count; MLP nearest-neighbour hats decode count-1 into units digit.
2-layer 1-head: L1 attn copies last digit; L2 attn sink-mass 1/(c+m(E-1)) encodes match count; MLP nearest-neighbour hats (calibrated) decode count-1 into units digit; tens digit always 0.
V1 with hat sharpness A=1000 but pos-11 gate left at -45: gate too weak, pos-11 output corrupted in ~2.5% of cases.
A=1000 with gate scaled as A/30: back to 100%, confirms the gate diagnosis.
V1 with layer-1 attention sharpness 2 (instead of 4): still 100%.
Layer-1 attention sharpness 1: too soft, copied last-digit is blurred -> 52.5%.
Layer-2 mask of pos-12 own key weakened to strength 1: still 100%.
No masking of pos-12 own key in layer 2: its digit token pollutes the count -> 32%.
Config A=300, gate A/30, L1S=4, EXCL=3, HEADPEN=10: 2-layer 1-head; L1 attn copies last digit; L2 attn sink mass encodes match count; MLP nearest-neighbour hats decode count-1.
final config with hat sharpness A=100 (gate A/30, HEADPEN=10): still 100%.
final config with hat sharpness A=3000 (gate A/30, HEADPEN=10): still 100%.
final config with '=' penalty at pos 12 reduced to 3: 100%.
'=' penalty removed entirely (HEADPEN=0): still 100%, the penalty was only needed to mask the earlier gate bug.
HEADPEN=0, layer-1 sharpness 8: 100%.
HEADPEN=0, layer-1 sharpness 1.5: too soft -> 40%; threshold between 1.5 and 2.
HEADPEN=0, key mask strength 0.5: leaks a little -> 90.5%.
Only 6 count classes (d_ff=12): 100% on the 200-example eval, but counts >6 are unrepresentable.
Only 4 count classes (d_ff=8): 99% (counts >4 fail), shows the count distribution tail.
All 10 count classes, HEADPEN=0 (d_ff=20): 100%.
Sink-mass gain halved to 0.05 without refitting BETA/GAMMA/R: thresholds no longer match -> 1%. Calibration constants depend on the gain.
Gate weight A/60 (weaker): 100%.
Gate weight A/150: too weak to silence the hats at pos 11 -> 92%.
V_POS gate offset off by -0.1: shifts all hat pre-activations, ties between classes -> 35%. Gate offset must be accurate.
Decode offset BETA shifted by +0.002 (half-spacing is ~0.009): still 100%.
Decode offset BETA shifted by +0.01 (more than half the m=1/m=2 spacing): 35%.
Fit constant R=5.5 instead of 6.158: thresholds off by ~0.016 -> 0%.
GAMMA 1.117 instead of 1.107: still 100%.
HEADPEN=0, layer-1 sharpness 2: 100%.
HEADPEN=0, layer-1 sharpness 3: 100%.
Final simplified: no '=' penalty in head (HEADPEN=0), gate A/30, L1S=4, EXCL=3, NC=10 hats; 2-layer 1-head sink-mass counting circuit.
